summary: Phase I-4c of the immutable Nex Core plan: the pool rollout coordinator run once on three booted image hosts in a nested QEMU lab (tests/integration/pool_rollout_lab.py, docs/qa/image/phase4-lab.md). The lab found one defect, fixed at its cause: the quorum-margin gate refused every pool on a host with no cluster software (an image without the nex-cluster layer has no corosync-quorumtool, the gate read the missing tool as an unreadable quorum, and a three-host pool could never leave quorum_margin); a missing corosync-quorumtool with no clustered storage now means there is no quorum to lose, and an installed but unreadable Corosync and clustered storage still refuse. The coordinator also reads NEX_POOL_UPDATE_STEP_TIMEOUT (a Go duration of at least one second) from the Core service environment when it starts, so a lab can watch the six-hour refuse pause; unset, nothing changes. No route, request or response changed.

guide.reason: No operator procedure changed or was walked through: the lab drives the rollout with a workstation Controller process, lab shells and loopback forwards, and the one behaviour change (a pool without cluster software no longer refuses a rollout for an unreadable quorum) removes a refusal rather than adding a step. update-a-pool.md stays unverified; docs/qa/image/phase4-lab.md records what ran and what did not.

api.reason: No route, request field, response field, status code or error code changed. The quorum_margin pause code is unchanged and is now returned in fewer cases; NEX_POOL_UPDATE_STEP_TIMEOUT is a service environment variable, not an API setting.

roadmap.reason: Phase I-4 of a proposed, not yet authorized plan; the lab ran the rollout on three booted image hosts but not the shutdown policy, a managed guest, Corosync or a master change, so no published milestone changes.

state.reason: Unchanged: the pool master's Core owns the rollout record (pool-update.json); the gate fix only changes when the master refuses to start the next host, and the lab's Controller process kept nothing the master did not.
state.record: The pool master's pool-update.json, as in docs/changes/2026-10-02-pool-rollout-coordinator.json.

verification.method: Three booted image hosts (two releases, pinned dev trust) in one pool, enrolled by a workstation nex-controller process; dry run, refuse pause, members then master, Controller kill and master power cut observed through the master's API; plus the agent regression test for the quorum gate (fails with the fix disabled). Lab binary was a workstation build bound over the image binary; see the QA record.
